name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold exploration company focused on acquiring mineral properties and royalty interests in Nevada's Walker Lane trend. The company holds an earn-in interest in the Lapon Canyon Gold Project, where an active 2026 reverse circulation drill program is targeting resource expansion with an NI 43-101 resource estimate as a near-term goal. Nevada Canyon operates an asset-light royalty, streaming, and project accelerator model to limit capital intensity while capturing exploration upside.
